description: Use this when someone asks to design, draw or plan a house, home, apartment, cabin, tiny house, extension, office, room, kitchen, bathroom or garden, wants a floor plan, a house plan, a room layout or a 3D model of a home, and no plan of theirs fits. Starts a new empty plan to scale in their account and returns its ID. Build it with edit_project and show it with open_editor.

title.description: The plan's name, such as Lake house.
